description: This file declares the class ProtobufIRReader, which extends IRReader to parse and convert Protocol Buffer based representations of ABI information into internal IR structures for header checking. It defines methods for reading various type and function information from protobuf messages.

classes.name: ProtobufIRReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and converting protobuf-encoded ABI information into internal IR representations.
